guide: Open Start and type your company name, grace days, late fee, renewal window, largest increase, income rule and deposit return days in the yellow cells.
List your owners on Owners, then each building on Properties with its owner ID.
Add every unit on Units with its type, size and market rent. Status, tenant and rent fill in from the leases.
Add each tenant on Tenants and each lease on Leases: unit, tenant, dates, rent, how often it is paid, deposit and yearly increase.
Post every amount due on Rent Roll — one row per rent period, fee or bill — and every payment on Payments against its charge ID.
Record deposits on Deposits; the return date and late alerts work themselves out after the lease ends.
Log enquiries on Applicants and visits on Viewings; the screening score compares each applicant with your rules.
Ninety days before a lease ends it shows as ending soon: make the offer on Renewals and check it is inside your cap.
Serve and track formal notices on Notices; agree payment plans for arrears on Payment Plans.
Print a tenant statement, invoice, receipt or lease summary from the printable sheets by choosing the ID in the yellow cell.
Send reminders and receipts from the Messages links: each opens WhatsApp with the text filled in.
Read the Rentals Dashboard and the Charts every week: occupancy, collections, arrears and renewals at a glance.

listing.title: Property Management Excel Template: Rent Roll, Tenant Ledger, Leases, Arrears, Deposits, Renewals, Screening, 15 Languages
listing.headline: Run rentals for many owners: rent roll, arrears, leases, renewals
listing.description:
Property management in one Excel workbook, built for managers who look after many owners, buildings and units.

Every rent period, fee and bill sits on a live rent roll. Payments are matched to the charge they settle, so each charge knows what was paid, when, how many days late and whether it was on time. Tenants, leases, units, properties and owners all update from the same records: balances, arrears ageing, occupancy, rent per square metre, the gap to market rent and the rent lost while a unit stands empty.

Renewals are checked against your largest allowed increase before the offer goes out. Applicants get a screening score against your own income and reference rules. Deposits show who holds them, the deductions and the date they must be returned. Payment plans show whether a tenant in arrears is on track. Every formal notice is logged with its deadline.

Six calculators answer daily questions: prorated rent, late fees, a defensible rent increase, tenant affordability, the cost of a lease break and a fair deposit return. Print a tenant statement, rent invoice, receipt or lease summary, or a lease agreement, late-rent notice, renewal offer or entry notice filled from your data. Sixteen WhatsApp messages open with the tenant's details already written in.

This is part one of the Property Management suite. Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, no macros, no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first.

messages.text: Hello {name}, a friendly reminder that {memo} of {amount} for unit {unit} is due on {due}. Thank you!
Hello {name}, we have not yet received {memo} ({balance}) for unit {unit}, due on {due}. Please pay today or let us know when you will.
Hello {name}, as your payment is {days_late} days late, a late fee of {fee} applies in line with your lease. Please contact us if you need help.
Hello {name}, thank you! We received {amount} on {date} for {for_what}. Reference: {ref}.
Hello {tenant_name}, your lease for unit {unit} ends on {end}. We would love you to stay — we will send you a renewal offer shortly.
Hello {tenant}, we have sent you a renewal offer for unit {unit}: {proposed} per payment until {new_end}. We look forward to your answer.
Hello {name}, your viewing of unit {unit} is confirmed for {date} at {time}. {agent} will meet you there. See you soon!
Hello {name}, thank you for applying for unit {unit}. We are checking your documents and will reply within two working days.
Good news {name}! Your application for unit {unit} is approved. We will send the lease and the move-in costs today.
Hello {name}, thank you for your interest in unit {unit}. We are unable to offer it to you this time. We will let you know about other units that may suit you.
Hello {name}, to complete your application for unit {unit} please send a copy of your ID and your last three payslips or bank statements.
Welcome home {name}! For anything you need in unit {unit}, message us here. Rent is paid by bank transfer or card; we send a reminder before each due date.
Hello {name}, we plan a short visit to unit {unit} on {deadline}. Please reply if another time suits you better.
Hello {name}, your next instalment of {each} under your payment plan is due. Paid so far: {paid}; still owed: {left}. Thank you for keeping to the plan.
Hello {tenant}, we have your notice for unit {unit}. Move-out day: {move_out}. Please leave the unit clean, return all keys and we will read the meters together.
Hello {tenant}, your deposit settlement for unit {unit} is complete. Thank you for being our tenant — we wish you all the best.

documents.title: Residential lease agreement
paragraphs: This lease is made on {col:leases.signed} between the landlord, represented by the managing agent, and {col:leases.tenant_name} (the tenant).
1. The property: unit {col:leases.unit} in property {col:leases.prop}, let for residential use only.
2. Term: from {col:leases.start} to {col:leases.end}. Renewal is by written agreement before the end date.
3. Rent: {col:leases.rent} paid {col:leases.freq}, due on day {col:leases.due_day} of the period. Rent paid after the grace period carries the late fee set out by the managing agent.
4. Deposit: {col:leases.deposit}, held as security and returned within the agreed days after move-out, less any lawful deductions for unpaid rent or damage beyond normal wear.
5. Use and care: the tenant keeps the unit clean, reports repairs promptly, does not sublet without written consent and allows entry for inspection or repair after notice.
6. Rent review: at renewal the rent may change by up to the agreed yearly increase of {col:leases.escal}, unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.
7. Ending the lease: either party gives written notice as required by law. Keys, meter readings and an inspection report are exchanged at move-out.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Notice of overdue rent
paragraphs: Dear {col:tenants.name},
Our records show an overdue balance of {col:tenants.overdue} on your account for unit {col:tenants.unit}. The oldest unpaid amount is {col:tenants.oldest} days late.
Please pay the full amount within 7 days of this notice, or contact us today to agree a payment plan. Late fees continue to apply as set out in your lease.
If you have already paid, please send us the payment reference so we can update your account. Thank you.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Lease renewal offer
paragraphs: Dear {col:renewals.tenant},
Your lease for unit {col:renewals.unit} ends on {col:renewals.end}. We would be glad to have you stay.
We offer to renew your lease until {col:renewals.new_end} at a rent of {col:renewals.proposed} per payment (currently {col:renewals.current}).
Please reply within 30 days to accept, or contact us to discuss. If we do not hear from you, we will start preparing the unit for new tenants.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

documents.title: Notice of entry
paragraphs: Dear {col:notices.name},
This is to let you know that we need to enter unit {col:notices.unit} for an inspection or repair.
Planned date: {col:notices.deadline}. The visit will take place during normal working hours and we will keep it short.
If the date does not suit you, please reply so that we can agree another time. Thank you for your cooperation.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.
